purpose: Temporal scalar UDF conversion optimization (#389), including mixed basic columns. Complete jobs retain runtime row input, both row/Arrow transposes, production IPC/JNI/state costs and rowwise blackhole output.

environment.java:
openjdk version "17.0.20.1" 2026-08-18
OpenJDK Runtime Environment (build 17.0.20.1+1-1-22.04-Ubuntu)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM (build 17.0.20.1+1-1-22.04-Ubuntu, mixed mode, sharing)
environment.measurement_source_state: Mixed-input changes were in the working tree above measurement_checkout_head. production_source_sha256 identifies the measured production files; these hashes match the shipping source.

engines.PREVIOUS: Actual preceding native callback, selected with directTemporalCalc=false. No synthetic wrapper.
engines.NATIVE: Direct JVM evaluation and unchanged timestamp buffer sharing enabled by default; includes verified mixed basic input columns.
engines.FALLBACK: Native planner installed with temporalUdf.enabled=false. Full stock fallback is asserted; perimeter control has no UDF and remains native.

methodology.order: Each fixture rotates all four routes per trial in one JVM. Most fixtures use a fresh JVM per shape; each has matched stock/previous/current/fallback controls.
methodology.noise: Shared 16-logical-CPU host, not an isolated machine. One-second samples record other Java/Doris activity, load and available memory. Retained final fixtures have no external rustc/cc1plus/cargo/javac processes, no outside-process set changes, and less than two outside logical CPUs per sample. Small differences and overlapping trial ranges are inconclusive.
methodology.selection: Only complete mixed-stage fixtures selected independently of timings are used for current claims. Earlier prototypes, competing-work attempts, all warmups, and unfavorable observations are retained.
methodology.native_evidence: Benchmark assertions require NativeCalc input consumption and both transposes. Current direct routes additionally require directTemporalRows; identity requires actual shared timestamp buffers. Pipeline additionally requires native GROUP BY consumption.
methodology.timing: Monotonic complete-job wall time around executeSql().await(). Planning and fixture preparation precede timing. No conversion cost is subtracted.

validation.controls: Callback-only and copy-only ownership controls pass; all six shapes pass smoke.
validation.notes: Released Arrow 18.3 emits a JNI loader class-descriptor warning under -Xcheck:jni, producing a Surefire dumpstream warning; all checks pass.
